notes.en: [[character:vodyanitsa]] is a support unit that uses her [[ability:skill]] to buff **[[element:freeze]] and [[element:stellar-swirl]]** teams in various ways. She additionaly provides healing and interruption resistance to the active character.

**In [[element:freeze]] teams,** her [[ability:skill]] reduces the [[element:hydro]] and [[element:cryo]] Resistances of opponents hit by her [[ability:skill]]. In addition, [[character:vodyanitsa]]'s A4 talent also increases the [[element:hydro]] and [[element:cryo]] DMG dealt by teammates, which scales based on her Max [[stat:hp|HP]].

**In [[element:stellar-swirl]] teams**, [[character:vodyanitsa]]'s [[ability:skill]] also enhances any [[ability:stellar-vortex]]es created by the [[element:stellar-swirl]] reaction. These enhanced Vortexes, when generated or exploded, also reduce enemies' [[element:anemo]] resistance. Her A4 talent will increase the [[element:stellar-swirl]] damage dealt by teammates, which scales based on her Max [[stat:hp|HP]].
notes.it: Nei team **[[element:stellar-swirl]]**, l'[[ability:skill]] di [[character:vodyanitsa]] potenzia anche tutti i [[ability:stellar-vortex]] generati dalla reazione [[element:stellar-swirl]]. Tali Vortici, quando vengono generati o esplodono, riducono anche la RES [[element:anemo]] dei nemici. Il suo Talento A4 aumenta i danni [[element:stellar-swirl]] inflitti dal team in base ai suoi [[stat:hp]] massimi.

notes.en: Triggering [[element:stellar-swirl]] at least every 8s while [[character:vodyanitsa]]'s [[ability:skill]] is active will prevent her A4 buffs from being applied to [[element:hydro]] and [[element:cryo]] damage, and instead only applied to [[element:stellar-swirl]] damage.

[[character:vodyanitsa]]'s A4 talent maximizes at 65,000 [[stat:hp|HP]]. This may be unreasonable to achieve without **[[weapon:hymn-of-the-maelstrom]]**, an **[R5] [[weapon:sacrificial-jade]]** or the assistance of [[element:hydro]] Resonance. Any more beyond this will only increase her healing capabilities and some of her damage.

content.en: When [[element:stellar-swirl]] is triggered, a [[ability:stellar-vortex]] is created. These vortexes explode after a short time. The more times [[element:stellar-swirl]] is triggered, the higher the explosion DMG of the vortex.
content.it: Quando viene provocato [[element:stellar-swirl]], viene generato un [[ability:stellar-vortex]]. Questi Vortici esplodono dopo poco tempo. Più volte viene attivato [[element:stellar-swirl]], maggiore è il danno inflitto dall'esplosione del Vortice.

content.en: [[character:vodyanitsa]]'s DMG buff to both [[element:freeze]] and [[element:stellar-swirl]] are provided through 35 Stacks: 25 to the on-field character, and 10 to the off-field character. When a character deals [[element:hydro]], [[element:cryo]], or [[element:stellar-swirl]] DMG, a Stack will provide at most 3500 DMG to [[element:hydro]] and [[element:cryo]] DMG, and 6500 DMG to [[element:stellar-swirl]] DMG. These stacks are refreshed when [[character:vodyanitsa]] uses her [[ability:skill]] again.
